omissionsAndDependencies: Expanded edition is dev-full index4; do not mutate old14/17/19 editions or claim V1 acceptance.
Expanded registry and native shared setter not implemented by this inventory change.

Production camera.select integration was newly written during this audit; compilation and runtime/device acceptance remain pending. Format/acceleration/torch must preserve saved startup intent and avoid owned/foreign capture races.
Microphone native handler stops any recording; endpoint must add exact-session approval/ownership checks before using it.
Assistant backend/config identity mutations need cancellation/config-epoch and explicit approval; no account, secret or privilege setters.
Native geometry/locale/layout changes invalidate pending image envelopes; no foreground capture performed.
Annotation scene editing needs finite item handles/scene revision and photo-on-exit grant; preferences are inventoried separately.
CPU/CUDA/Maxine/realphone/device support must be returned from runtime capabilities; this inventory asserts no hardware acceptance.
Bound string settings and geometry on wire without pretending the native widgets already enforce the same caps.
Full source-control/roundtrip/native-handler equivalence and both-adapter tests remain required.
